## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — fixes a bug
- [ ] `feat` — new functionality

- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch comes off `main` and uses the right prefix (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `test/`, `refactor/`, `ci/`).
- [ ] The commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] If this is a `fix`, I added the regression test (fails before the fix, passes after).
- [ ] If I touched `src/`, I ran the build and committed the regenerated `index.html`. I did not edit `index.html` by hand.
- [ ] I tested the bookmarklet by hand in the affected mode.
- [ ] I read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the change fits the project scope.
